records.name: 黃月英
records.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent character cutout for the CatDynasty wiki. Edit target: the supplied game screenshot. Extract ONLY the central illustrated character and their original equipment; remove every UI element, all Chinese labels, level/power numbers, buttons, portrait frame, parchment/background, floor and unrelated ink splashes. Preserve the original hand-drawn watercolor/ink illustration, face, costume, colors, proportions, pose and accessories. Where the level label overlaps the bottom of the character, restore only the small occluded contour naturally and faithfully. Center the entire character in a square canvas with a small even transparent margin, no clipped extremities. Output real transparent alpha, not a checkerboard, no opaque backdrop. No text, added objects, redesigned costume or restyling. Subject: 黃月英, the white fluffy cat with pale silver hair, face covering, red and gold wide-sleeved robe, black cat mask on the chest and black cat-head staff above the right shoulder. Keep the staff, ribbons, tail and original pale gold magical aura as part of the character; the empty areas around and between them must be transparent.
